observations: Large cylindrical portable speaker with black fabric mesh covering.
Top-mounted control panel with buttons for Power, Mode (M), TWS/Link, EQ, Volume Down/Previous, and Volume Up/Next.
Five LED battery/status indicator lights located above the buttons.
Metal attachment points for a carrying strap on both ends.
Black nylon shoulder strap with metal swivel clips.
A small red fabric tag is visible on the lower side in photo 1.
No brand logo or model name is visible on the exterior mesh or control panel.

Bass performance cannot be assessed through photographs.
Volume and acoustic power are subjective and cannot be verified from images.

response.reason: The brand and model are not visible in the provided photos. Because the market value depends heavily on whether this is a genuine brand-name product or a generic clone, identification is required before pricing.
